name: growth-division-spatial
description: A single CPM cell (CpmGrowthDivision) grows via per-cell dFBA on an abundant, uniform 60x60 glucose field (spatio-flux DiffusionAdvection) and divides at a volume threshold using the native engine call divide_cells, compounding into a small lineage over the run. Tuned (glucose_vmax=1.5, vol_threshold=80, reset_target=40) for a clean 1->2->4 staircase without runaway past the lattice.

provenance.source: task-3 growth-division composite (mirrors single-cell-in-a-field + tests/test_cpm_growth_division.py tuning)
